overview: Albania is a country in the Balkans, on the eastern shores of the Adriatic and Ionian seas. Its capital and largest city is Tirana. Albania was ruled by the Ottoman Empire for more than four centuries and declared independence in 1912. After decades of strict communist rule that cut it off from much of the world, it became a multi-party democracy in the early 1990s, and it joined NATO in 2009.

geography.text: Most of Albania is mountainous, with the Albanian Alps in the north and long ranges running down the country. A strip of coastal plain lies along the Adriatic, while the south faces the Ionian Sea. Albania shares three large lakes with its neighbours: Lake Shkodër with Montenegro, Lake Ohrid with North Macedonia, and Lake Prespa with North Macedonia and Greece.
